decisions.summary: Wave 109 fixes three rows (328 ranking 25, 26, 46) by the docs/buildings.md claim lines alone; no sheet, no engine code
decisions.why: The three rows are open in-scope Mode A rows (kept, no wave) that FR-001 carries; each is UNCLAIMED or MISLABELED, a finding about a claim, so the claim line is the whole fix the ranking names. Magistracy procedure is in scope under 328's amendment 8.

decisions.summary: Wells#bath-area well relabeled GUESS on 0105's drawing page; the optional fourth well 'only for very large compounds' claimed apart as UNRESEARCHED
decisions.why: Exactly the ranking row 46's fix. 0105's drawing page line 8 says the one well filling the bath 'is our reading', so GUESS is what the record holds; no page gives a well count by compound size, so UNRESEARCHED is honest. No rule weakened.

decisions.summary: The residence along the inner court's north range claimed on 0091's drawing page (garden to the south, the shady north band behind)
decisions.why: Ranking row 26's first named fix. 0091's drawing page records the garden on the sunny south and the shady north band behind the residence (its lines 31, 34), which places the house on the north range.

decisions.summary: The hand plans' karo's own house inside the compound claimed as the GUESS 0106's drawing page records
decisions.why: Ranking row 25's fix. 0106's drawing page (line 8) records the small house of the karo's own on the hand-drawn sheets as a GUESS and that no page places a chief retainer's house inside the compound; the claim says the same.
